messages:
Ruth: quick heads-up 1: we launched compactify-slimmer v1.0 as a small pilot (7% traffic) at 07:20 UTC. short summary and bench snippets below.
Owen: nice, curious for numbers.
Ruth: paste (pilot vs baseline):
```
workload | p50 -> p50 | p99 -> p99 | unit cost
rwd-7b-short | 44ms -> 31ms | 230ms -> 195ms | 1.00 -> 0.90
rwd-13b-short | 72ms -> 52ms | 460ms -> 388ms | 1.00 -> 0.87
multiturn-short | 38ms -> 28ms | 210ms -> 178ms | 1.00 -> 0.89
```
Kai: solid numbers, especially p50. what's changed under the hood?
Ruth: algorithm tweak: compactify-slimmer avoids creating full KV rewrite for small deltas and instead emits compact append ops; plus a cheap prefilter that drops noop merges for identical prefix segments. net: fewer merge tails and less queueing for short sequences.
Elena: worker/resource impact?
Ruth: canary nodes show CPU +5-8% during spikes, memory ~flat, IO slightly reduced. overall throughput per-GPU up a bit due to reduced queue stalls. no GC/OOM signals.
Owen: any client-facing issues so far?
Ruth: deploy-bot health snapshot: all green; one transient 502 during an unrelated upstream retry storm at 07:33 that predates the pilot logic. deploy-bot output:
```
{"pilot":"compactify-2949","duration_min":40,"checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true,"throughput":true},"anomalies":["502@07:33 - upstream retry storm (unrelated)"]}
```
Kai: what's the rollout plan and rollback criteria?
Ruth: rollout: 7% -> 25% in 2h -> 55% in 8h -> 100% in 24-36h if green. auto-rollback triggers: sustained p99 > baseline + 40% for 5m OR error rate > 0.9% for 3m. ops playbook has a tenant-level mute flag if we need to exempt enterprise tenants.
Elena: can you add a short ops snippet for muting and the exact flag names?
Ruth: yes, will add to the PR and ops playbook. quick snippet for reference:
```
# ops: mute compactify for tenant
optimizations:
  compactify_slimmer: false
```
Owen: please create a 2-slide summary for infra sync (before/after + rollback/playbook) and a one-liner for execs when we hit 100%.
Ruth: exec one-liner draft: "Compactify-slimmer v1.0 pilot cut short-request p50 by ~30% and p99 by ~15%, reducing unit inference cost ~11% in pilot; staged rollout underway."
Kai: add a note for support to watch top enterprise tenants for any latency chatter.
Ruth: will ping support and CS. full bench write-up and PR: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/5218
Owen: thanks team 1, great incremental win.
deploy-bot: pilot-monitor: next summary in 10m.
Ruth: leaving pilot watch on; ping here for anything urgent.
